caption: Cost of the mechanism, per DNP3 request-response exchange. (a) End-to-end response time per transaction class; boxes span the quartiles and whiskers the full observed range. The median rises by 22.7 ms for READ, 22.6 ms for SELECT and 21.2 ms for OPERATE. (b) Frames and captured bytes per exchange on the master-facing link, which are equal in the two arms. The switch also generates internal blocker traffic, which never reaches the master-facing link and is therefore outside this measurement.
